_about: Defaults for the observer interface. Presentation only: nothing here changes what the simulation computes. A viewer's own choices, kept in their browser, come first. Reset in the Layers panel returns the layers to this file.

_help.accessibility.theme: Theme (Appearance). Dark, light, or following each viewer's system. A viewer's own choice in their browser comes first. Accepts: "system" (Follow the system), "dark" (Dark), "light" (Light). Default: "system". Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.accessibility.color_vision: Colour vision (Appearance). Palettes for road and severity colours that do not rely on telling red from green, or blue from yellow. Accepts: "standard" (Standard), "protanopia" (Protanopia), "deuteranopia" (Deuteranopia), "tritanopia" (Tritanopia), "monochrome" (Monochrome). Default: "standard". Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.reduce_motion: Reduce motion (Appearance). Short fades instead of movement. Following the system uses each viewer's own setting. Accepts: "auto" (Follow the system), "on" (On), "off" (Off). Default: "auto". Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.accessibility.reduce_transparency: Reduce transparency (Appearance). Solid surfaces instead of glass. Accepts: true or false. Default: false. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.accessibility.high_contrast: High contrast (Appearance). Text at full strength, firmer edges and outlines. Accepts: true or false. Default: false. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.accessibility.advanced: Specialist detail (Appearance). Off, measures meant for specialists (identifiers, hashes, coordinates) give way to plain language. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.notifications.enabled: Notifications (Notifications). What happens in the simulation appears over the map as it happens. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.notifications.dnd: Do Not Disturb (Notifications). Notifications are kept in history without being shown. Accepts: true or false. Default: false. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.notifications.important_first: Important first (Notifications). An alert goes ahead of what is waiting to be shown. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.notifications.max_visible: Shown at once (Notifications). How many notifications the capsule holds before it groups the rest. Accepts: a whole number from 1 to 8. Default: 3. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.notifications.dwell_ms: Shown for (Notifications). How long a notification stays before it gives way. Accepts: a whole number from 1000 to 60000 ms. Default: 7000. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.auto_focus.mode: Auto Focus (Auto Focus). Whether the camera follows what matters: offered once per run, on, or off. Accepts: "enable-force" (On), "enable" (Offer once per run), "disable" (Off). Default: "enable-force". Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.auto_focus.strategy: Order (Auto Focus). Which event the camera shows: each in turn, or always the latest. Accepts: "round-robin" (Each in turn), "latest" (The latest). Default: "round-robin". Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.auto_focus.dwell_seconds: Stays for (Auto Focus). How long the camera stays on one event before the next, in turn. Accepts: a number from 2 to 120 s. Default: 9. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.auto_focus.zoom: Closeness (Auto Focus). How close the camera goes to an event: 1 frames it, more goes closer. Accepts: a number from 0.2 to 8 ×. Default: 1.6. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.playback.skip_seconds: Back and Forward jump (Playback controls). How far the observer's Back and Forward buttons, and J and L, go. Accepts: 60 (1 minute), 300 (5 minutes), 900 (15 minutes), 1800 (30 minutes), 3600 (1 hour). Default: 900. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.playback.step_seconds: Step (Playback controls). How far Step, and K, advance before holding. Accepts: 1 (1 second), 10 (10 seconds), 60 (1 minute), 300 (5 minutes). Default: 60. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.playback.fine_control: Ask how far (Playback controls). Back and Forward open a menu of distances each time, instead of one jump. Accepts: true or false. Default: false. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.clock.hour12: 12-hour clock (Clock, units and news). Times as 3:00 PM instead of 15:00. Holding the clock switches it at any time. Accepts: true or false. Default: false. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.display.byte_units: Data sizes (Clock, units and news). Decimal (kB, MB, as drives are sold) or binary (KiB, MiB, as memory is counted). Accepts: "decimal" (Decimal (MB)), "binary" (Binary (MiB)). Default: "decimal". Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.news.style: News style (Clock, units and news). Realistic News, written by a model where one is available, or the standard plain lines. Accepts: "realistic" (Realistic), "standard" (Standard). Default: "realistic". Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.layers.roads: Roads (Map layers). Shown when a viewer first opens the observer; each can change their own. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.layers.traffic: Traffic (Map layers). Roads coloured by how congested they are. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.layers.vehicles: Flow markers (Map layers). Vehicles moving along the roads. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.layers.signals: Signals (Map layers). Signalled junctions and their phases. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.layers.buildings: Buildings and places (Map layers). Footprints, and the places that draw traffic. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.layers.place_names: Place names (Map layers). Names beside places, as there is room. Accepts: true or false. Default: false. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.layers.other_places: Unclassified places (Map layers). Places with no kind of their own. Accepts: true or false. Default: false. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.layers.labels: Street names (Map layers). Names along the roads. Accepts: true or false. Default: false. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.layers.weather: Weather (Map layers). Rain cells as they cross the district. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.layers.flooding: Flooding (Map layers). Roads under water. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.layers.incidents: Incidents (Map layers). Collisions, breakdowns and closures. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.layers.events: Demand (Map layers). Places drawing extra traffic now. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.tutorial.enabled: Tutorial (Tutorial). The guided tour is offered from the header. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.tutorial.show_on_startup: Show at start-up (Tutorial). The tour opens by itself, once, when a viewer first arrives. Accepts: true or false. Default: false. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.asb.enabled: Report how it keeps up (Backpressure). The observer tells the server how far behind it is, so Adaptive Simulation Backpressure can ease the rate before it falls behind. Accepts: true or false. Default: true. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
_help.asb.report_interval_ms: Report every (Backpressure). How often it reports. Accepts: a whole number from 250 to 10000 ms. Default: 1000. Applies to observers opened from now on; a viewer's own choice comes first.
